headline: Nevish Line Reignites as Heavy Fighting Engulfs Callahan's Passage and Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, combat has flared anew along Nevish Line, which leads the front with rapid base exchanges across Grief Mother and Blackcoat Way. In Callahan's Passage, grinding attrition continues unabated with over two thousand casualties in two hours and renewed fighting around Crumbling Post. Weathered Expanse remains heavily contested, registering three bases reduced to neutral ground alongside active clashes near Crow's Nest and Wightwalk. Fresh base transfers have also struck Stonecradle around Trammel Pool, marking another point of tactical friction. Meanwhile, the aggressive turnover previously seen in Palantine Berm and Mooring County has tapered off over the past two hours, though skirmishing and casualties persist. Other sectors, including Linn of Mercy and Marban Hollow, maintain high casualty rates despite a lull in territorial flips, while the far rear hexes remain entirely calm.
